summary.purpose: P1 playtest item (東沙→觀塘 case): move_organization charged a flat cost of 1 and never checked destination faction applicability. Per rules.md 組織遷移: wall-crossing (牆內↔牆外) costs 2 movement points and may only move 1 step (multi-step rail-3 paths can no longer traverse the wall — the BFS is same-side-only), and the destination town must be within the moving faction's development space (taiwan_green cannot enter 觀塘 at all). Same-side moves and the Chek Lap Kok airport path (already 2 moves) are unaffected.
